Former Glencore Oil Executives Plead Not Guilty
: Two former Glencore plc (GLEN) oil executives pleaded not guilty at London court to multiple charges linked to alleged corrupt payments in West Africa; trials and legal proceedings are ongoing.
: Glencore (GLEN) declared a US$0.17 per share distribution. Jersey shareholders can elect GBP, EUR or CHF by Sept 1, 2026. FX set by LSEG 4pm London rate on Sept 7; pay date Sept 18, 2026.
: Glencore (GLEN) is reportedly pursuing a deal to operate and access output from Venezuela’s Venalum aluminum smelter, competing with Mercuria in government talks; no final agreement confirmed.
Glencore Considers Rio Tinto Ownership Move
: Glencore (GLEN), 70% owner of the Aurukun bauxite JV, says handing project ownership to Rio Tinto—given its regional bauxite operations—offers the best path for future development.
: Cochilco data for July reported that copper production at the Collahuasi mine—jointly owned by Glencore plc (GLEN) and Anglo American—rose 12.3% year‑on‑year to 38,400 tonnes.
